name: services/theses/search_history_affect
description:
Add a thesis to search history.

This method aims at improving user experience while searching. Call this method once your user visits thesis' page, or when he/she selects a given thesis while searching for theses, etc.

Given thesis will be added to search history (currently stored separately for each consumer key and each user). Items saved in search history may appear more frequently in search results.
brief_description: Add a thesis to search history.

arguments.name: ths_id
arguments.description: The ID of the thesis you want saved to the search history.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.
